name: tensorflow
description: An Open Source Machine Learning Framework for Everyone
one_liner: A foundational open-source library for building and training machine learning models — the engine under the hood, not something an end user ever sees directly.
buyer: Not really a direct buyer; it's infrastructure. The realistic beneficiary is a company already building ML products who uses it as a free building block, not something to resell itself.
business_use_cases: An ML engineering consultancy uses it as the base framework when building custom models for clients, billing for the expertise, not the library.
A company trains an in-house demand-forecasting model on top of it instead of buying an off-the-shelf forecasting SaaS.
A university spinout builds a research prototype on it before commercializing a narrower product.

money_ideas.idea: Custom model development services for companies that need ML but lack in-house expertise.

steal_this: Not a weekend product opportunity on its own — it's plumbing. Skip building 'on top of TensorFlow' as a pitch; the value is in the specific model you build, not the framework.
